quest.title: Water Beneath the Lanterns Flows Deep
quest.description: The most awaited moment of the Lantern Rite is the time when a giant Mingxiao Lantern released into the sky on the night of the fifth day. And the size of the Mingxiao Lantern this year is a sight that you don't want to miss, as the levitation stone used to make the giant lantern float this year is the biggest in 20 years. On this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have prepared a Xiao Market, which was built using the same materials as the lanterns. When you arrived at the Xiao Market, the event organizer Huixin asked you for a favor...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Oh, hello you two. Many thanks for your donation to Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Today, I have another matter to discuss with you. Not a donation this time; more of a sales and purchase situation. Interested?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure beats working for free, like last time! Paimon's interested.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Haha, wonderful! I appreciate the help. Now, let me explain the situation...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I need two kinds of Plaustrite for official festival use.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: One is called Azurite. It is occasionally found in the northern part of Mt. Tianheng.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: When Azurite gets caught in the roots of ordinary vegetation, it sometimes produces Bloatty Floatties, which have floating seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: The other one is called Vermillionite, which is extremely dangerous as far as most people are concerned...

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: In Guili Plains, old Ruin Hunters who have lost the power of flight use Vermillionite to keep themselves airborne.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it! So, Azurite and Vermillionite, right?

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: (Actually, they're just blue and red varieties of Plaustrite... Gemstone merchants only gave them fancy names to try and impress their customers...)

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: That's right. Please get some of each for me. Good luck!

talks.objective: Obtain Vermillionite from the Ruin Hunter
Go back to Xiao Market and talk to Huixin

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ooh... These are some fine pieces of Azurite and Vermillionite!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: My thanks to you both. Here's your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: None of your efforts are wasted. Every piece adds that bit more luster and color to Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Since you're staying in Liyue during the festival, make sure to keep an eye on the Mingxiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: As the work progresses, the construction site at the harbor will become more and more magnificent to behold.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sounds fascinating. {NICKNAME}, how about we take a look now?

talks.objective: Have a look at the construction site

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Look, over there! That guy's acting very suspicious, don't you think?
Hey, whatcha doin'?
Whatcha staring at me like that for? Get gone!
Wha— Huh?
...Alright, if you all won't get gone, I'm just gonna get going myself I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. Paimon thought he might be a shady character, then he opened his mouth and now Paimon's sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He must have been up to something when he was crouching down on the ground. Because as soon as he saw us approaching, he stood up and acted all innocent...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon has a bad feeling about this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What could he be up to? Let's investigate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This area is full of construction supplies for the Mingxiao Lantern: paper, oil, wood...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On the final day of the Lantern Rite festival, huge crowds come out to watch the Mingxiao Lantern being released.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It can't be a good sign if there's a suspicious character lurking around somewhere so dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If he's been tampering with the stockpile of lantern supplies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a matter for the authorities! Quick, let's go to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs and report it at once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, you're taking this very seriously. Why?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Because... Because... Everyone in Liyue has worked really hard for this! No-one should be allowed to spoil it, period!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What's the real reason?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Because... Near the harbor is that Zhongyuan Chop Suey place! Take one bite, hooked for life! The original and best!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Clearly their marketing campaigns have been effective.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: （test）这么多纸，万一烧起来的话…

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Hold up! This is the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We are here to report some suspicious activity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we saw a shady-looking guy snooping around near the stockpile of highly flammable Mingxiao Lantern supplies!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We absolutely cannot let this be the end of Zhongyuan Chop Suey!

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Hmm, goodness! This is a serious matter indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly what Paimon thought! Liyue Harbor's cuisine is the heart and soul of the city—

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...It seems we disagree on where the seriousness of the matter lies. But you're not wrong, my little friend.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I have noted your concerns and will pass them on diligently to my superiors.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Thank you. You were right to report this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Make sure it's given top priority! It needs to be dealt with properly!
